extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the store.

extDescription.message: Shows the name of your bookmark as the tab title whenever a bookmarked page is open.
extDescription.description: Short description shown in the browser and the store (max 132 characters).

popupUnsupportedBody.message: Browsers don't let extensions change this page.

popupNoBookmarkBody.message: Bookmark it and the tab takes the name you give it.

openedFrom.message: Shown because this tab came through this bookmark.

optionsIntro.message: Choose how far each bookmark name reaches: only its address, the pages under it, pages whose address contains a text, or the whole site.

optionsCount.message: $ON$ of $TOTAL$ bookmarks keep their name beyond their own address

optionsNoMatchBody.message: Try another name, address or folder.

optionsNoBookmarksBody.message: Bookmark a page (Ctrl+D, or ⌘D on a Mac) and it shows up here.

menuScope_below.message: Name on this address and the pages under it

menuScope_contains.message: Name on pages whose address contains “$TEXT$”

menuScope_containsEmpty.message: Name on pages whose address contains…

scopeLabel.message: Where the tab keeps this name

appendTitleHint.message: The tab shows “bookmark name — page title”, e.g. “Mail — (3) Inbox”. For every bookmark, unless it has its own choice (“Page title” in its row or in the popup).

pageTitleHint.message: Add the page's own title after the name, for this bookmark. Overrides the setting for every bookmark.

backupHint.message: Save how far each name reaches and the page title choices to a file, or load them from one, e.g. in another browser. They apply to every bookmark with the same address.

importSummary.message: The file has $TOTAL$ settings: $MATCH$ for your bookmarks and $OTHER$ for addresses you have no bookmark for yet, which start working when you add one.

importErrorFile.message: This is not a Bookmark-Tab Title settings file.

importErrorSize.message: The file is too large (over 5 MB).

importErrorQuota.message: There is not enough room in the browser's synced storage for these settings. Nothing was changed.

containsHint.message: Also for links opened from mail. Separate alternatives with a space.

howIntro.message: A bookmarked page shows the bookmark name as its tab title. For each bookmark you choose how far the name reaches:

howExact.message: Only on the bookmarked address itself.

howBelow.message: After the tab has been on the bookmarked address, also on every page under it — e.g. example.com/docs, then example.com/docs/guide.

howContains.message: In every tab, also for links opened from mail: every page of the bookmark's site whose address contains the text. Made for several accounts — /u/1/ or authuser=1 at Google, a Play Console developer id, a Cloud project=… Separate alternatives with a space.

howHost.message: After the tab has been on the bookmarked address, on every page of the site.

howWins.message: The most specific one wins: the page's own bookmark, then “address contains”, then “this address and below”, then the last “whole site” bookmark the tab came through. After a page with a bookmark of its own, the next page returns to that whole-site name.

howTrail.message: Leaving the site ends “this address and below” and “the whole site”; a link opened in a new tab keeps them. The choice is the same here, in the extension's popup and when you right-click a page.
